description: A Claude Code 2.1.306 transcript with session tag entries written by the matching Agent SDK's local tagSession writer.
note: Claude Code's transcript serializer is not published. The pinned changelog documents /tag. In the matching Agent SDK 0.3.306 (claudeCodeVersion 2.1.306), the local tagSession writer in sdk.mjs appends {type: tag, tag, sessionId}, encoding a cleared tag as an empty string.
